status_definitions.STATED: Directly stated in the contract package; transcription verified in two passes.
status_definitions.INTERPRETED: A reviewed reading of stated text (a derivation, classification or cross-reference). The note says what was inferred.
status_definitions.AMBIGUOUS: Legible, but the package supports more than one reading or two provisions conflict; see contract_ambiguities.json.
status_definitions.NOT_PROVIDED: The contract refers to evidence the task data does not supply.

money_convention: Money is integer minor units: *_cents are USD cents, *_halalas are SAR halalas. Rates of exchange, index values, factors and percentages are decimal strings. No float appears in this file.

extraction.method: Visual transcription of page renders (PyMuPDF; pass A at 150 dpi full page, pass B at 220 dpi half-page crops) by an AI assistant (Claude Code, model claude-opus-5-5). No OCR engine, no external sources. Invoice, line and report data were not consulted to choose, correct or confirm any value or reading.
extraction.clause_text: Narrative pages (clauses, Parts, schedule notes) were read in full in pass A (150 dpi) and transcribed verbatim from the pass B 220 dpi crops; every source_text is a verbatim excerpt. Table values were compared programmatically across both passes; quotations were not.
extraction.runtime_note: The audit reads this file; it never re-reads the PDF.

provenance.source_text: DIRECTIONAL DRILLING SERVICES CONTRACT DRILLING CAMPAIGN 2025
NORTHGATE PETROLEUM OPERATING COMPANY ("the Company")
MERIDIAN DOWNHOLE SERVICES LTD ("the Contractor")
Currency United States Dollars (USD)
All invoices are stated and paid in USD.
Value Added Tax 15 per cent
Value Added Tax is charged at 15 per cent of the net amount of the invoice, rounded under Clause 17.

value.when: at each step of the Clause 18 build-up

provenance.source_text: Rounding to the cent, half to even, at each step

Every amount is ascertained in cents. Where a step of the build-up in Clause 18 produces a fraction of a cent, the result of that step is rounded to the nearest cent before the next step is applied, and a result exactly half way between two cents is rounded to the even cent.
Commencement date 01 January 2025
Expiry date 31 December 2025
The Term as let ran from 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2025.
As twice extended it runs from 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2026.
The Expiry Date stated in the Form of Agreement is extended to 31 December 2026

invoice_discount.comparison_note: INTERPRETED from "exceeds": a sum of exactly 250,000.00 attracts no discount.
invoice_discount.basis: the excess of the sum of the amounts of the services charged on the invoice over the threshold
invoice_discount.rounding: Clause 17 (half to even, to the cent)
invoice_discount.presentation: a single charge under code DS-900 with a negative amount
invoice_discount.scope: each invoice alone, not the Contractor's invoices taken together (P11)
invoice_discount.order: rate discounts under Supplement No. 2 / Amendment No. 2 are taken before it; the net amount includes the DS-900 charge (Clause 36)

provenance.source_text: Where the sum of the amounts of the services charged on an invoice exceeds 250,000.00 USD, the Contractor allows a discount of 4 per cent of the excess, rounded under Clause 17, stated as a single charge under code DS-900 with a negative amount.
The discount under Clause 38 is calculated on each invoice alone and not on the Contractor's invoices taken together.
The net amount of an invoice is the sum of the amounts of its charges, including the discount charge under Clause 38.
On an invoice whose services total 312,400.00, the discount charge under Clause 38 is -2,496.00.

provenance.source_text: No uplift is payable for work at night; the rates in Schedule 1 cover continuous operations. No uplift is payable for work on a public holiday.

standby.rule: On a Standby day a service is charged at the Schedule 3 Part 3 percentage of its operating rate; a service marked not chargeable is not charged on a Standby day in any quantity. Services charged per well or for a loss are charged in full whatever the status of the day. DD-121 is charged only on a Standby day, in place of DD-120.
standby.personnel: Personnel are charged on a Standby day at the standby percentage for their position (P13).
standby.status_source: The status of the day is as recorded on the Daily Drilling Report (cl. 19), recorded by the Company Representative and final (R7).

provenance.source_text: The rate for a charge is the Schedule 1 rate, or for item PD-210 the Schedule 2 rate, to which is applied, in this order and no other: first the hole section factor in Schedule 3 Part 1, where the service is section-rated; then the well class factor in Schedule 3 Part 2, where the service is class-rated; then the standby percentage in Schedule 3 Part 3, where the day is a Standby day. Each step is rounded under Clause 17. The amount for the charge is the quantity multiplied by the rate so built up.

depth_bands.split_rule: Where the metres drilled on a day cross a band boundary, the metres in each band are charged as a separate charge stating the depths at which that part starts and ends.

provenance.source_text: Item PD-210 is charged at the rate for the band in which the metres lie (Clause 23). A boundary depth belongs to the shallower band.
The rate is class-rated under Schedule 3 Part 2 and is not section-rated.

Where the metres drilled on a day cross a band boundary, the metres in each band are charged as a separate charge stating the depths at which that part starts and ends. A boundary depth belongs to the shallower band. Bands end at 1,500 m, 3,000 m and 4,500 m. Item PD-210 is charged only on the performance-drilled sections nominated in the call-off.
Schedule 2 footage rates are unaffected.

provenance.source_text: The services below are priced against the Rig Services Index, base 100.00 (Clause 17A). The rate stated in Schedule 1 for them is a base rate.

The rate for a service listed in Schedule 2C is the base rate stated in Schedule 1 multiplied by the Rig Services Index published for the calendar month in which the service was performed and divided by the base index, rounded half to even. That figure is the rate for the purposes of Clause 17.

lost_in_hole.conversion: SAR value converted into USD at the published rate for the month of the loss, rounded half to even, before depreciation (31A)

depreciation.hours_basis: circulating hours the tool accumulated on the well on which it was lost, including the day of the loss, as stated on the Lost in Hole Report (Part E)

lost_in_hole.charge: the result rounded under Clause 17 and charged as one unit on the day of the loss
lost_in_hole.standby: charged in full whatever the status of the day (Schedule 3 Part 3 intro)

provenance.source_text: Where a tool cannot be recovered, the charge is its replacement value in Schedule 6 less depreciation of 1 per cent for each complete 25 circulating hours the tool accumulated on the well, as stated on the Lost in Hole Report, to a depreciation of not more than 50 per cent. The result is rounded under Clause 17 and charged as one unit on the day of the loss.

The replacement values in Schedule 2D are stated in SAR and are converted into the currency of the Contract at the rate of exchange published in that Schedule for the month in which the tool was lost, rounded half to even, before the depreciation in Clause 31 is applied.
Circulating hours for Clause 31 are those the tool accumulated on the well on which it was lost, including the day of the loss.
The tools were bought in riyals and the values below are stated in SAR. They are converted into the currency of the Contract under Clause 31A at the rate published for the month of the loss.
Depreciation is 1 per cent for each complete 25 circulating hours, to not more than 50 per cent (Clause 31).
With 412 hours the depreciation under Clause 31 is 16 per cent.

provenance.source_text: A Daily Drilling Report shall be issued for every day on which the Contractor is on the well. ... It is signed by the Company Representative and the Contractor's lead directional driller.

Each Daily Drilling Report bears a number in the series DDR, and that number is quoted against every line of that day on the invoice. The report is written by the Contractor's supervisor in the ordinary words of the rig and does not repeat the descriptions in Schedule 1 or carry the service codes.

records.parts_rule: One Daily Drilling Report per well and day carries, as numbered parts, every other record the Contract makes a condition of payment; there are no separate run, survey, source or loss documents. A part that does not apply to the day is omitted; a part that applies and is absent is a record not delivered.

condition_of_payment.rule: A charge for a service Schedule 5 lists is not payable until the part named has been completed in the Daily Drilling Report for the day or run the charge is for (cl. 37).

records.other_field_records_clause_16: A BHA Run Report at the end of each run; a Gyro Survey Report for each day a gyro survey is taken; a Source Handling Certificate for each run carrying a radioactive source; a Lost in Hole Report for each tool that cannot be recovered.

reporting_rules.text: The lead directional driller is responsible for the accuracy of the Contractor's entries on the Daily Drilling Report.
The Daily Drilling Report for a day is issued by 06:00 on the following day.
Measured depths are stated in whole metres from the rotary table.
Circulating hours are stated in whole hours, any part hour of thirty minutes or more counting as a whole hour.
The report lists by service code every rental tool in the hole at any time during the day.
The report states, by service code, the number of the Contractor's personnel on the rig during the day.
The status of the day is recorded by the Company Representative and is final for the purposes of Clause 19.
A report may be corrected only by a revision signed by both signatories before the invoice for the day is submitted.
The BHA Run Report is issued within two days of the end of the run and totals the circulating hours and metres of the Daily Drilling Reports for the run.
Survey data are delivered in the Company's format within twelve hours of each survey.
LWD data are delivered in real time where the tools allow and in memory form at the end of each run.
The Contractor shall retain all field records for seven years after the end of the Contract.

provenance.source_text: One Daily Drilling Report is issued for each well and day (Clause 19). It carries the operations summary and, as numbered parts, every other record this Contract makes a condition of payment. There are no separate run, survey, source or loss documents.

A charge for a service below is not payable until the part named has been completed in the Daily Drilling Report for the day or run the charge is for (Clause 37). A part that does not apply to the day is omitted; a part that applies and is absent is a record not delivered.

A BHA Run Report is issued at the end of each BHA run ... A Gyro Survey Report is issued for each day on which a gyro survey is taken, a Source Handling Certificate for each run carrying a radioactive source, and a Lost in Hole Report for each tool that cannot be recovered.

chargeability.text: The status of a day, Operating or Standby, and the hole section for that day are as recorded on the Daily Drilling Report for that day. A charge shall state the status and the hole section of the day it is for.

On a Standby day a service is charged at the percentage of its operating rate stated in Schedule 3 Part 3. A service Schedule 3 Part 3 marks as not chargeable is not charged on a Standby day in any quantity.

Item DD-120 is charged per circulating hour recorded on the Daily Drilling Report for an Operating day, subject to a minimum of 6 hours on any Operating day on which the tool is in the hole. On a Standby day item DD-120 is not charged and item DD-121 is charged instead.
Personnel are charged per person-day for the persons recorded on the rig on the Daily Drilling Report. No service is charged on any day in a quantity above the daily limit in Schedule 3 Part 5.

Item PD-210 is charged for the metres drilled on the day, taken from the measured depths on the Daily Drilling Report, at the rate of the Schedule 2 depth band in which the metres lie. ... Item PD-210 is charged only on the performance-drilled sections nominated in the call-off.
Items LW-410, LW-411 and LW-412 are charged for the metres drilled on an Operating day while the tool is in the hole, which are the metres logged.
Item RM-510 is charged for the metres drilled on an Operating day while the underreamer is in the hole, which are the metres reamed.

Item DD-111 is charged once for each BHA run carrying a positive displacement motor, on the last day of that run. Item LW-420 is charged once for each BHA run carrying a radioactive source, on the first day of that run.

Items MB-701 and DD-140 are charged once for the well, on the first day on the well. Items LW-430 and MB-702 are charged once for the well, on the last day on the well; item LW-430 only where logging while drilling was run.
A rental charged by the day is charged for a day only where the Daily Drilling Report records the tool in the hole on that day.
No service is charged twice for the same well and the same day, save that item PD-210 may be charged more than once on a day for different depth intervals under Clause 23.
Gyro surveys, formation pressure points, wiper trips, back-reaming hours and clean-out runs are charged in the numbers recorded on the Daily Drilling Report for an Operating day.
Where a tool cannot be recovered, the charge is its replacement value in Schedule 6 less depreciation ... charged as one unit on the day of the loss.
No service is charged for a day on which the rig is moving between wells; such days are not days on the well.
A day lost to weather is recorded as Standby on the Daily Drilling Report.
Where a tool fails in the hole, the day remains an Operating day for the other services; the failed tool is charged only on days the report records it in the hole.
A person on a crew change day is counted once, whether arriving or departing.
The minimum in Clause 21 applies to each Operating day separately and is not averaged over a run.
Personnel are charged on a Standby day at the standby percentage for their position in Schedule 3 Part 3.
The Company may suspend the services on any well. A day of suspension recorded as Standby on the Daily Drilling Report is charged under Clause 20.
For a service charged by the hour, the first hour of each period in the hole is rig-up and is not a Chargeable Hour. The report states the hours run; the invoice charges one fewer.
Metres charged not exceeding the metres the report supports by more than 1 per cent are payable as charged. Metres exceeding that are payable at the figure the report supports.
The number charged on a day is the number recorded on the Daily Drilling Report (Clause 22), not the number shown here.
The hole sections shown are those the tool is designed for; which tools are in the hole on a day, and are charged, is as the Daily Drilling Report records (Clause 28).
What each service covers and the event its charge is for. Item DD-102 is office based and is charged per day for each coordinator the Daily Drilling Report records.

billing_rules.text: The Contractor shall invoice each well separately, for a period of consecutive days on the well. Every charge on an invoice is for a day within the period the invoice states.
An invoice shall not be submitted before the last day of its period and shall be submitted within 30 days after it.

Each charge states the date, the service code, the description, the hole section, the status of the day, the quantity, the unit, the rate and the amount, and for item PD-210 the depths at which the charged interval starts and ends.
A charge is stated in the unit Schedule 1 gives for the service, and in no other.
The net amount of an invoice is the sum of the amounts of its charges, including the discount charge under Clause 38.
A charge for a service Schedule 5 lists is not payable until the document Schedule 5 names has been delivered for the day or run the charge is for.
Value Added Tax is charged at 15 per cent of the net amount of the invoice, rounded under Clause 17.
The total of an invoice is its net amount plus Value Added Tax.
The Company may withhold a disputed charge and shall pay the undisputed balance.
The Company shall pay within forty-five days of receipt of a correct invoice.
Each Daily Drilling Report bears a number in the series DDR, and that number is quoted against every line of that day on the invoice.

Where an Amendment substitutes a rate with effect from a date before the date it was issued, an invoice submitted before that date of issue was correct at the rate then in force. The difference on services already invoiced is shown as a single adjustment on the first invoice submitted on or after the date of issue, and on no other.
Services performed on or before the extended Expiry Date are chargeable under this Contract; services performed after it are not.
All invoices are stated and paid in USD.
Pricing a service requires the date on which it was performed, not the date of the invoice; nothing in an instrument reopens a service already charged at the rate then chargeable.
